olivia.support: Customer reports ~2k audit log lines missing from their Splunk index after our forwarder run. They see manifests in S3 but Splunk only got ~200 events. Ticket: INC-8421. Can eng-sec / SRE take a look?

carla.engsec: thanks olivia. can you paste a sample manifest key + object size and the forwarder job id? suspicious if gzip objects were skipped or deduped by the forwarder.

olivia.support: here are the keys they gave: `s3://redwood-audit/tenant-424/2026-02-18/part-00012.gz` size 1.2MB, `s3://redwood-audit/tenant-424/2026-02-18/part-00013.gz` size 0.0MB (weird). forwarder job id `fw-20260218-09-11-33`. Customer says they see repeated identical actor events in source and expect them all.

ben.sre: 0-byte gz is a clue. that object probably created during cleanup or partially uploaded and should be skipped by forwarder. what does the forwarder log show for `fw-20260218-09-11-33`?

olivia.support: pasted logs from forwarder here: ```
[2026-02-18T09:11:35Z] fw-20260218-09-11-33 INFO processing s3://redwood-audit/tenant-424/part-00012.gz len=1213342
[2026-02-18T09:11:36Z] fw-20260218-09-11-33 WARN skipping s3://redwood-audit/tenant-424/part-00013.gz reason=zero_length
[2026-02-18T09:11:40Z] fw-20260218-09-11-33 INFO forwarded 198 events to splunk index=acme-audit
[2026-02-18T09:11:42Z] fw-20260218-09-11-33 INFO suppressed 180 events dedupe_key=actor:12345 window=5s
```

mike.support: aha `suppressed` line. forwarder has a dedupe filter turned on for that tenant (config flag `suppress_duplicates=true`) to reduce noise. That would drop repeated identical events within a short window. Customer expects raw lines though.

carla.engsec: can you confirm tenant config? sometimes suppress_duplicates gets enabled by policy when sample rate low. also we need to confirm schema differences — suppression uses a normalized fingerprint built from `actor`, `action`, `resource`, and `timestamp` truncated to seconds. if customer expects repeated events with identical keys, they will be collapsed.

olivia.support: verified in tenant metadata: `suppress_duplicates: true` and `dedupe_window_seconds: 5`. Customer alleges they need full fidelity for compliance. they asked for guidance on repro/backfill.

remy.cs: flagged as compliance-impacting. customer requests immediate backfill and a config change. what's the safe rollback?

ben.sre: safe steps: 1) temporarily set `suppress_duplicates=false` for tenant-424 (API: `PATCH /v1/tenants/424` body `{ "suppress_duplicates": false }`) 2) re-run forwarder on the S3 prefix with a replay job id `replay-424-20260218` which will read manifests and forward all objects, skipping zero-byte objects. 3) for any gz that previously produced suppression metrics, we need to pull raw objects and re-ingest with a replay flag that disables dedupe at runtime. 4) provide the customer a signed manifest of re-sent S3 keys for their audit.

carla.engsec: addtional check: confirm HMAC headers and Splunk HEC responses. suppression is internal; it doesn't modify object contents but the forwarder will drop duplicates before HEC POST. so backfill will produce the missing lines. also confirm KMS decrypt success for the objects — if decrypt fails we might skip quietly.

olivia.support: logs show KMS decrypt OK for `part-00012.gz`. `part-00013.gz` zero-length so ignore. customer wants a playbook we can run now.

ben.sre: here's minimal repro/playbook (run from ops box): ```bash
# patch tenant to disable suppression
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"suppress_duplicates": false}' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/424
# trigger replay job (will read manifests and forward all objects)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant_id":424,"prefix":"tenant-424/2026-02-18/","replay_reason":"customer backfill suppressed events"}' https://api.redwood.internal/v1/forwarder/replay
```

remy.cs: thanks, can you also add the timeline and an SLA note to the ticket? customer wants confirmation by EOD.

mike.support: I'll update ticket INC-8421 with ETA ~4 hours for config change + 1-2 hours for replay, depends on object count. sending customer a redacted sample of the events we will re-send for approval before we start. :thumbsup:

ingest-bot: deploy-notification: forwarder v2.8.1 rolled to prod in us-west-2 at 2026-02-10T03:22:11Z. no s3-handling changes in this release.

carla.engsec: follow-up action items: - ops: perform tenant config patch and start replay with explicit `disable_dedupe=true` flag - support: get customer sign-off on sample before replay - eng-sec: audit the tenant policy that toggled `suppress_duplicates` and check if any policy automation misapplied it. I'll take that.

olivia.support: ack, I'll coordinate and post status updates here.

mike.support: update: config patched at 2026-02-18T12:03 UTC, replay job started `replay-424-20260218-01`, ingestion reported 2,015 events forwarded, 0 suppressed. customer confirmed receipt of 1,980 additional lines (they filtered some duplicates themselves). closing loop with customer now.

carla.engsec: thanks team — please attach the replay manifest to INC-8421 and mark as resolved after customer confirms. also add a short retro note about the tenant policy automation rule. :white_check_mark:
